review_candidates.description: At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.com. As guided by Our Credo, Johnson & Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson & Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit. Job Function Supply Chain Engineering Job Sub Function Automation Engineering Job Category Scientific/Technology All Job Posting Locations: Gent, East Flanders, Belgium Job Description As an Industrial IT Systems Engineer, you own assigned systems and play a central role in managing and improving our ISA‑95 Level 1 & 2 Industrial IT landscape across the Ghent sites. You are accountable for keeping Industrial IT applications stable, secure, and compliant and for bringing new systems successfully into daily operations. Working closely with engineering, IT, QA, cybersecurity, and external vendors, you deliver a reliable, future ‑ proof, and continuously improving Industrial IT environment . You combine solid technical expertise with structured execution, sound judgement, and a hands‑on approach. Tasks and Authorizations Own assigned Industrial IT applications and ensure stable, compliant, and reliable operations. Diagnose and resolve system issues and implement improvements that increase performance and availability. Participate in a rotating weekend on‑call service to safeguard system continuity. Execute and coordinate essential lifecycle activities, including configuration, monitoring, documentation, user management, patching, backup, and recovery. Coordinate with IT, engineering, and vendors on system upgrades, integrations, and the deployment of new Industrial IT applications. Plan and execute commissioning, testing, validation, and operational readiness activities for new or updated systems. Take an active role in deviations, CAPAs, investigations, audits, and continuous improvement initiatives. Communicate clearly with stakeholders about system health, risks, decisions, and project progress. Qualifications We are looking for a solid technical foundation combined with relevant professional experience and the ability to translate expertise into independent system ownership. Relevant professional experience with Industrial IT, industrial automation, or related systems in a manufacturing or regulated environment. Solid grasp of network fundamentals, including TCP/IP, VLANs, routing, segmentation, and firewalls. Ability to use scripting languages such as PowerShell or Python to automate routine tasks. The skills below are not mandatory but provide a strong advantage in this role. Knowledge of the pharmaceutical industry (GxP, GAMP, qualification, etc.) Knowledge of particle monitoring platforms—ideally LMS Pharma (SE Geoscada) Understanding of Windows Server–based applications, including basic troubleshooting and system administration. Familiarity with data historian solutions such as AVEVA PI or similar time‑series data platforms. Awareness of Industrial IT cybersecurity principles (NIS2, ISA‑95, Purdue Model) is an asset. Working knowledge of Active Directory for user and access management. Knowledge of backup and recovery solutions used in Industrial IT environments. Experience with Industrial IT monitoring tools, such as PRTG. Attitude Prioritizes quality and safety in every decision and action. Works as an open, collaborative team player with a strong service mindset. Acts in line with Johnson & Johnson’s Credo and Leadership Imperatives, integrating them into daily work and decision-making. Takes ownership of assigned systems, projects, tasks, and problems and acts proactively. Applies a structured, analytical approach to problem-solving and continuously expands knowledge of Industrial IT technologies. Organizes and prioritizes work independently, coordinates effectively, and follows through on commitments, including under pressure. Communicates clearly and constructively, focusing on solutions and alignment with stakeholders. Education & Experience Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Industrial Automation, Electromechanics, Industrial Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or Computer Science with Industrial IT affinity — or equivalent relevant experience. Typically, at least three years of relevant professional experience in Industrial IT, industrial automation, manufacturing IT, or a comparable technical environment. Languages Excellent command of English (spoken and written). Strong proficiency in Dutch (C1 level) is preferred. #SCEngineer Required Skills Preferred Skills: The Anticipated Base Pay Range For This Position Is €60,000.00 - €96,255.00 Benefits In addition to base pay, we offer the following benefits*: an annual bonus with set target (% of pay) depending on pay grade / location, where the actual amount is based on the employees’ and companies’ performance of the previous calendar year, or sales commissions. We also offer service anniversary and recognition awards, and subject to the terms of their respective plans, employees - and in some location’s eligible dependents - can participate in several insurance plans. For more information, visit Employee benefits | Supporting well-being & career growth | Johnson & Johnson Careers. This is for informative purposes only. review_candidates.title: System Engineer
review_candidates.description: Over Multipharma Werken bij Multipharma, de belangrijkste coöperatie in de Belgische apotheekwereld, betekent meer dan zomaar een job kiezen . Bij ons draag je mee bij aan iets groots: een positieve impact op de gezondheid van onze 1,3 miljoen patiënten en om en bij 900.000 coöperanten. Met ons netwerk van meer dan 320 apotheken, 1 distributiecentrum en 2 innovatieve centra voor de individuele verpakking van geneesmiddelen op maat van de patiënt, leveren we niet alleen geneesmiddelen, maar bouwen we actief mee aan de toekomst en vernieuwing van de farmaceutische zorg. Met een 2200-tal toegewijde medewerkers vormen we een sterk team dat elke dag het beste van zichzelf geeft om voor onze patiënten te zorgen. Samen maken we de farmaceutische zorg toegankelijk voor iedereen. Waar je ook werkt, in een apotheek, een distributiecentrum of op het hoofdkantoor: de gezondheid van onze patiënten staat altijd centraal want hun gezondheid is onze zorg! Bij Multipharma ben je meer dan een collega, we zorgen ook graag voor jou zodat je via onze opleidings- en welzijnsprogramma’s jouw kennis, expertise en welzijn kan doen groeien. Jouw werkdag We zijn op zoek naar een klantgerichte en oplossingsgerichte systeemingenieur die de netwerkinfrastructuur van Multipharma op een efficiënte, veilige en betrouwbare manier zal monitoren, ondersteunen, opbouwen, integreren en beheren. In deze functie help je de continuïteit, beschikbaarheid en goede werking van ons netwerklandschap te waarborgen, zowel op het hoofdkantoor als in de apotheken en in door partners beheerde omgevingen, in nauwe samenwerking met onze interne teams en externe servicepartners. Als systeemingenieur en lid van het IT-infrastructuurteam ben je medeverantwoordelijk voor het operationele beheer, de stabiliteit en de ontwikkeling van de netwerkinfrastructuur van Multipharma. Jouw Taken Je houdt toezicht op, ondersteunt en beheert LAN-, WAN-, wifi-, firewall-, VPN- en connectiviteitsdiensten in al onze kantoren, apotheken en datacenters. Je werkt nauw samen met externe partners op het gebied van netwerken, telecommunicatie en beveiliging om de kwaliteit van de dienstverlening, het oplossen van incidenten, het levenscyclusbeheer en voortdurende verbetering te waarborgen. Je fungeert als technisch aanspreekpunt voor toegewezen netwerkdiensten, volgt de activiteiten van partners op en stelt voorgestelde oplossingen waar nodig ter discussie. Je analyseert incidenten en problemen, coördineert activiteiten voor het oplossen van storingen en implementeert of volgt duurzame corrigerende maatregelen op. Je houdt proactief toezicht op de beschikbaarheid, prestaties en beveiliging van het netwerk, rapporteert over bevindingen en KPI’s, en onderneemt actie om verslechtering van de dienstverlening of downtime te voorkomen. Je bereidt netwerkgerelateerde wijzigingen voor, plant deze en voert ze uit volgens het wijzigingsbeheerproces, inclusief validatie-, communicatie- en uitwijkprocedures. Je draagt bij aan netwerkinfrastructuurprojecten, upgrades, migraties en standaardisatie-initiatieven, samen met interne collega’s en externe partners. Je draagt bij aan beveiligings- en compliance-initiatieven door ervoor te zorgen dat netwerkconfiguraties, toegangscontroles en operationele werkwijzen voldoen aan interne normen en governancekaders. Je stelt technische documentatie op en onderhoudt deze Jouw werkplek Je werkt op een hybride manier, maar ons hoofdkantoor in Anderlecht is jouw basis. Wie je bent Je Kwalificaties Je hebt een bachelor- of masterdiploma in informatietechnologie, of hebt door ervaring gelijkwaardige expertise opgebouwd. Je hebt minimaal 2 jaar relevante ervaring in netwerkengineering, systeemengineering of infrastructuurbeheer. Je beschikt over praktische kennis van concepten op het gebied van bedrijfsnetwerken, zoals routing, switching, VLAN’s, wifi, WAN-connectiviteit, VPN, firewalls, DNS, DHCP en netwerksegmentatie. Je bent bekend met netwerkmonitoring, incidentanalyse, probleembeheer, veranderbeheer en operationele rapportage. Je hebt ervaring met het samenwerken met externe partners op het gebied van infrastructuur, netwerken, telecommunicatie of beveiliging en bent in staat hun technische werkzaamheden te coördineren, op te volgen en te valideren. Kennis van Cisco, Meraki, firewalltechnologieën, SD-WAN, netwerktoegangscontrole, monitoringplatforms of IT-beveiligingsstandaarden is een pré. Je beschikt over automatiseringsvaardigheden of bent zeer gemotiveerd om deze te ontwikkelen, waarbij je gebruik maakt van scripting- en automatiseringstools zoals PowerShell, Python, Ansible API-integraties, infrastructuurautomatisering, configuratiesjablonen of workflowautomatisering om de operationele efficiëntie te verbeteren en repetitieve handmatige taken te verminderen. Jouw moedertaal is Nederlands of Frans, beschikt over professionele werkvaardigheid in de andere landstaal en hebt een goede beheersing van het Engels, zowel schriftelijk als mondeling. Profiel Je combineert sterke analytische vaardigheden met het vermogen om verbanden te leggen tussen netwerkcomponenten, systemen en operationele processen. Je blijft kalm in veranderende of onvoorziene omstandigheden en past je aanpak doelgericht aan. Je kunt effectief samenwerken met collega’s, belanghebbenden binnen het bedrijf en externe partners, en je communiceert duidelijk over prioriteiten, incidenten, veranderingen en risico’s. Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor de toegewezen netwerkdiensten en voelt je op je gemak bij het coördineren van complexe activiteiten binnen een vastgesteld kader. Je bent bereid om je werkterrein geleidelijk uit te breiden tot buiten het netwerkgebied en bij te dragen aan andere domeinen binnen de IT-infrastructuur, zoals cloud, systemen, beveiliging, werkplek of operationele tools, afhankelijk van de prioriteiten van het team en de bedrijfsbehoeften. Je formuleert praktische alternatieven bij het oplossen van problemen en richt je op duurzame verbeteringen in plaats van op kortetermijnoplossingen. Je investeert in je eigen technische ontwikkeling, deelt expertise met collega’s en draagt bij aan de kennisbasis en best practices van het team. Samen groeien bij Multipharma Een uitdagende en gevarieerde functie waarin je verantwoordelijkheid krijgt en actief bijdraagt aan de strategie en groei van Multipharma. Een mooi en competitief salaris met daarbovenop heel wat extralegale voordelen: groepsverzekering, hospitalisatieverzekering voor jou en je gezin, personeelskorting, verlof aangevuld met ADV-dagen Benefits at Work, maaltijdcheques (een gsm-abonnement, voucher voor de aankoop van een gsm, bedrijfswagen met tankkaart of oplaadkaart en een bonus) Groeien en leren: wij bieden een breed scala aan (vakspecifieke) opleidingsmogelijkheden zodat je jezelf zowel professioneel als persoonlijk kan blijven ontwikkelen. Een fantastisch team dat je met open armen ontvangt in een moderne omgeving. Denk aan high fives, leuke babbels en een gezellige sfeer. Doen waar je goed in bent en waar je blij van wordt, binnen een stabiele en gezonde organisatie waar solidariteit, empathie en expertise centraal staan. Enkele dagen per week van thuis werken? Dat kan! We bieden je de ruimte en kansen om je ambities waar te maken: bij ons kan je horizontaal, verticaal of diagonaal groeien en helemaal op jouw tempo. Klaar om mee het verschil te maken?

review_candidates.title: IT Operations Administrator (f/m/d)
review_candidates.description: About Focused Energy Focused Energy is a pioneering international deep-tech company with locations in Germany and the US, dedicated to commercializing laser-driven nuclear fusion. Our mission is to deliver clean, safe, and virtually limitless energy to the world. As we rapidly scale, we seek talented individuals who thrive on bringing clarity and structure to fast-growing environments. Join us as a IT Operations Administrator to help shape the future of clean energy. In this role, you will own the systems, processes, and enablement that keep our IT environment secure, scalable, and consistent. You will ensure platforms are configured correctly, access is managed accurately, operational processes are followed, and employees are trained and confident in using the tools they need to succeed. About The Role As Focused Energy grows across multiple sites, the IT Operations Administrator will own the systems and processes that support reliable day-to-day IT delivery globally. You’ll administer SaaS platforms, manage user access and licences, maintain clear IT processes, and enable employees to use their tools confidently. This is a systems and process ownership role not a traditional helpdesk position and works closely with the IT Operations Manager, IT Support Specialist, and People Operations. What You’ll Do Own SaaS platform administration across all Focused Energy sites, including user accounts, licences, access rights, and approved access changes. Execute IT processes consistently, identify process gaps, and keep documentation accurate and current. Design and deliver user training that helps employees use core IT tools confidently and reduces tool-related support needs. Coordinate onboarding and offboarding IT activities with People Operations, ensuring new starters have the required access on day one and leavers are fully deprovisioned on time. Build and maintain an accessible library of IT process documentation, user guides, and self-service resources. Conduct regular licence audits, identify unused licences, and flag cost or access anomalies to the IT Operations Manager. Partner with the IT Operations Manager and IT Support Specialist on access reviews, cross-site coordination, and IT improvement initiatives. Apply IT processes and standards consistently across locations while responding effectively to the needs of a technically diverse, globally distributed workforce. Who You Are You work independently within established processes and proactively identify routine work that needs to be done. You are highly organised and reliable, with strong attention to detail in account provisioning, access changes, licence management, and audit activities. You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical colleagues and keep stakeholders informed without over-escalating. review_candidates.description: We are growing. And we are looking for talented people. At Decskill, we believe that technological excellence is driven by human talent. We are an IT consulting company with more than 10 years of consolidated experience in the market, focused on building long-term relationships with both our clients and our people. Today, we are a community of over 800 professionals, working from Lisbon, Porto, and Madrid, contributing to impactful technology initiatives. As part of the Astek Group, we combine a strong local culture with a global presence, being active in around 23 countries across 4 continents. This allows us to offer an international context, diverse challenges, and long-term career opportunities, while staying close to our teams. We would like to meet a Senior Platform Engineer – Azure for a project with a remote working model. What You’ll Do: Work closely with internal and external stakeholders, developers, and engineering teams to deliver high-quality solutions on time. Design, implement, and continuously evolve Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions. Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration, and operational tasks using Terraform, Terragrunt, Ansible, and scripting . Build reusable Terraform modules, automation, and golden paths that enable development teams to provision and consume infrastructure through self-service. Continuously improve our infrastructure platform by reducing manual processes, operational toil, and technical debt. Design and improve CI/CD pipelines supporting infrastructure and application delivery. Manage and evolve our Microsoft Azure infrastructure and services, ensuring scalability, reliability, security, and cost efficiency. Contribute to the management and evolution of our Kubernetes / AKS environment as part of the wider platform. Design and implement new platform capabilities that improve reliability, scalability, quality, and developer experience. Promote Cloud Native, DevOps, SRE, Infrastructure as Code, and GitOps best practices across teams. Support FinOps principles and continuously identify opportunities for cloud and infrastructure cost optimisation. Analyse, troubleshoot, and resolve complex infrastructure and platform incidents, ensuring root causes are identified and recurrence is prevented. Establish and promote code review, testing, validation, and quality practices for infrastructure and automation code. Help build a culture where infrastructure and operational processes are managed through version-controlled code rather than manual provisioning and administration . What We’re Looking For: Strong hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code , particularly Terraform , including reusable modules, state management, and infrastructure automation. Experience designing reusable infrastructure, automation, and platform capabilities, with a strong focus on standardisation and self-service . Knowledge of configuration management and automation tools, preferably Ansible . Strong practical knowledge of GitLab and GitLab CI/CD , including pipeline development and automation. Professional experience with public cloud platforms, preferably Microsoft Azure . Good knowledge of Kubernetes and containerisation . Familiarity with GitOps methodologies , preferably Argo CD . Ability to develop automation using Python, Bash, or similar scripting/programming languages . Good understanding of DevOps, Cloud Native, and SRE principles . Experience with code repositories, code reviews, automated testing, and software engineering best practices. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, combined with a proactive and autonomous mindset. Fluency in English is mandatory. Nice to Have: Strong knowledge of Kubernetes / AKS and the wider CNCF ecosystem . Experience with observability , including monitoring, logging, and distributed tracing. Familiarity with developer self-service and automation, particularly using Atlassian tools such as Jira, Confluence, and JSM . Good knowledge of Linux administration and troubleshooting . Understanding of FinOps and cloud cost optimisation . Experience with internal developer platforms and developer tooling. Exposure to Agile ways of working , particularly Kanban. Relevant certifications in Terraform, Azure, Kubernetes , or related technologies. A strong curiosity and motivation to learn new technologies and continuously improve processes. Excellent autonomy, critical thinking, problem-solving, and collaboration skills. Are you looking for an environment that values curiosity and commitment? Here, your contribution has real impact and individual growth is taken seriously. Find with us the right opportunity to grow! What you can expect from us Long-term projects with national and international context. Opportunities to grow technically and professionally A people-first culture, focused on transparency and trust. Teams that value ownership, collaboration and stability. Join us: Send us your CV in English to daniela.adao@decskill.com with reference “ DA/PE ”. Your next challenge might start here.

review_candidates.title: IT Asset Manager / Software & IT Services Manager
review_candidates.description: FREEDOM FINANCE TECHNOLOGIES is a Cyprus-based fintech company and part of the international financial holding Freedom Finance. We develop and maintain trading and banking IT products, as well as the holding's IT infrastructure worldwide. Our team currently consists of 170 professionals. Over the past three years, we have grown fourfold and continue to actively expand our team. Since 2009, we have been developing our core product - a trading system for brokerage operations in the stock market. More than 700,000 users across 41 countries use our applications. We are looking for a proactive specialist to lead the Software Asset Management (SAM) function within our company. We need someone who can bring order to our software and service portfolio, eliminate unnecessary costs and subscriptions, and become a trusted partner for the business in selecting and implementing the right IT tools. Responsibilities: Audit & Inventory Management Conduct a comprehensive audit of all software and cloud services (SaaS) used across the company. Create and maintain a single, up-to-date software inventory. Cost Optimization Identify duplicate services, unused licenses, and unnecessary subscriptions. Optimize software licensing costs. Business Collaboration Gather requirements from different business departments, analyze their needs, and identify the most suitable software solutions to support business processes. Selection of Key Systems Research, evaluate, and participate in the implementation of business-critical systems, including: Project Management Systems (Jira, Asana, Monday, or equivalent). Access Management Systems / Identity Providers (IdP) (Okta, Keycloak, JumpCloud, or equivalent). Software Lifecycle Management Ensure timely software updates and license renewals. Onboarding / Offboarding Processes Design, automate, and oversee processes for granting software access to new employees and promptly revoking all access upon employee departure. Requirements Software Asset Management (SAM) Experience Proven experience conducting software audits and maintaining software license and service inventories in organizations with 100+ employees. Business-Oriented Mindset Ability to communicate effectively with both technical teams and business stakeholders, gather requirements, and translate them into technical specifications for software selection. Broad Knowledge of Enterprise Software Strong understanding of the modern enterprise software landscape, including task management tools, CRM, ERP, HR platforms, collaboration tools, and IAM/IdP solutions. Analytical Mindset Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work with large volumes of data while taking a structured approach to cost optimization. Onboarding / Offboarding Experience Experience designing or participating in employee onboarding and offboarding processes related to IT infrastructure Excellent written and verbal Russian is essential for this role Nice to Have Experience with dedicated SAM/ITAM platforms (such as Jira Service Management, Snipe-IT, or equivalent). Basic understanding of information security principles related to access management and permission matrices. Benefits Fully remote work. Daytime and evening working hours according to the Moscow time zone. A service contract with a Cyprus-based company. Fixed monthly salary in euros. Paid annual leave of 21 working days. Paid sick leave. Public holidays: New Year holidays until January 4-6, plus May 1-2 or May 8-9. One additional paid day off per month. Coverage of professional training courses related to your area of work. Coverage of participation in professional online conferences. Training on products and processes. A genuinely comfortable and professional working environment. Opportunities to grow and develop alongside the company and its products.

review_candidates.title: Growth Outbound
review_candidates.location: Santa Cruz de Tenerife, Canary Islands, Spain
review_candidates.description: The role Chekin's outbound channel doesn't exist yet in its scaled form. The strategy is set, the data sources are identified, and the first phase is mapped — what's missing is the person who builds it, validates it with real signal, and gives it speed. You'll turn market data — public per-country data, plus signal scraped from Booking and Airbnb — into a repeatable engine that generates qualified pipeline toward mid-market hotels and chains. This isn't a "run the sequences" role. You're building the engine, not operating someone else's. What you'll do We think in phases, not quarters — each one earned with data from the last, not with more budget. First 30 days Get two engines live in parallel: a Clay + Lemlist motion on our net-new, multi-property pipeline — with proper enrichment, multichannel sequencing, and deliverability hygiene from day one — and a HubSpot-based nurture motion on our owned database. Ship your first message-angle test with success criteria defined before you start, and put a clean handoff agreement in place with Sales. 60–90 days Hit Gate 1: a sustained reply rate above 8–10% for three-plus weeks, with a message angle you know is winning. Start moving your best accounts — the ones with real property-count signal — into 1:1 hyper-personalized outreach. Build a real feedback loop with our AEs, and document the playbook so it isn't just in your head. 180 days Hit Gate 2: your playbook works in more than one market or ICP, not just the pilot. At that point, outbound is a predictable, quota-attributable source of pipeline, not an experiment. If the case is there, this is also where you start building the "brain" of the system — signal scoring, message QA, routing — without touching the deliverability layer that's already working. What you'll bring You've done this before, not just run it: Demonstrable experience building and validating B2B outbound from scratch, with real results to show for it — reply rate, meetings, pipeline — not just executing sequences someone else designed. Hands-on with the stack: Clay or Apify, Lemlist (or Smartlead / Instantly), HubSpot, and Make or n8n. You take deliverability seriously — warmup, domain rotation, LinkedIn limits — because you've seen what happens when it's ignored. AI is part of your actual daily workflow, not a buzzword: research, copy, scoring, and personalization at scale. Day to day, you're comfortable with: Designing an outbound playbook end-to-end — signal, message, response — not just running what's handed to you. Sourcing and structuring data: scraping, enrichment, and cleaning, using tools like Clay and Apify. Multichannel sequencing (email + LinkedIn) with the deliverability discipline to keep it working at volume. Operating HubSpot like an owner: lists, workflows, lead routing, and knowing why cold outbound comes in as a lead, not an MQL. Automating logic in Make or n8n as the system matures. Enough fluency in paid and SEO to brief an agency and read the results, even if you're not the one running them. Reading your own funnel — reply rate, cost per meeting, cost per opportunity — and using it to decide what to do next. Nice to have: experience with per-prospect reasoning tools like Enginy for hyper-personalized outreach at the top of the funnel. What we offer Base salary range from 40000€ to 45000€ yearly. Bonus structure based on role-specific objectives. Remote work from anywhere in Spain. It is also possible to work in a hybrid format at our office in Tenerife. 23 vacations days per year Strategic role with real impact on market expansion. Professional growth within a fast-scaling international company. Collaborative, innovative, and ambitious team culture. Who thrives here We're looking for someone who builds systems with real autonomy rather than waiting to be handed one, thinks in pipeline and quota rather than task lists, and treats every message angle as a hypothesis to test rather than a guess to defend. You'll work closely with Sales, so communicating clearly and closing the loop matters as much as the technical build.

review_candidates.title: Executive Office Manager
review_candidates.description: L’Executive Office rappresenta il punto di raccordo tra la Direzione Generale, gli organi societari, le diverse funzioni aziendali e gli interlocutori istituzionali. Assicura il presidio organizzativo, amministrativo e relazionale della Direzione, favorendo un’efficace gestione dei flussi informativi, delle attività di governance e della comunicazione istituzionale interna ed esterna. Ti occuperai di: • gestire e coordinare l’agenda del Direttore Generale, organizzando incontri, riunioni, appuntamenti istituzionali e trasferte; • curare le comunicazioni in entrata e in uscita, incluse la corrispondenza istituzionale, le PEC e i rapporti con stakeholder interni ed esterni; • predisporre e revisionare lettere, presentazioni, report e materiali informativi destinati alla Direzione, agli organi societari e agli interlocutori istituzionali; • monitorare richieste, scadenze e attività di competenza della Direzione, assicurando il follow-up delle decisioni assunte; • organizzare e coordinare le riunioni del Consiglio di Amministrazione, delle Assemblee dei Soci, del Comitato di Direzione e degli altri comitati aziendali; • gestire i relativi flussi documentali e autorizzativi, garantendo ordine, riservatezza e puntualità; • presidiare il protocollo e contribuire alla corretta archiviazione e conservazione della documentazione societaria e amministrativa; • contribuire alla predisposizione di comunicati, note informative, lettere agli stakeholder e materiali di comunicazione istituzionale; • supportare l’organizzazione di eventi e incontri con investitori, autorità, enti pubblici, associazioni di categoria e partner; • contribuire a rendere efficace e coerente la comunicazione tra la Direzione Generale e i dipendenti, in coordinamento con le funzioni aziendali coinvolte. Si richiede: • preferibile laurea in discipline economiche, giuridiche, linguistiche o affini; • esperienza di almeno 5 anni in ruoli di Executive Assistant, Assistente di Direzione o in attività organizzative e amministrative analoghe; • eccellenti capacità organizzative, di pianificazione e gestione delle priorità; • ottime capacità relazionali e comunicative; • precisione, affidabilità, riservatezza e autonomia operativa; • ottima capacità di redazione e revisione di documenti e comunicazioni professionali; • padronanza del pacchetto Microsoft 365 e familiarità con gli strumenti di gestione documentale; • ottima conoscenza della lingua tedesca e della lingua italiana; la conoscenza della lingua inglese costituisce titolo preferenziale; • capacità di operare con interlocutori diversi, mantenendo un approccio professionale, collaborativo e orientato alla soluzione. Cosa offriamo • un ruolo centrale e trasversale, a stretto contatto con la Direzione Generale e con le diverse funzioni aziendali; • l’opportunità di conoscere da vicino i processi decisionali, organizzativi e di governance della Società; • un ambiente di lavoro dinamico, professionale e collaborativo; • inserimento e inquadramento al 1° o 2° livello del Ccnl Commercio e Terziario, con retribuzione commisurata all’esperienza e alle competenze della persona selezionata. Invii la Sua candidatura caricando il CV in risposta all’annuncio nella sezione “Lavora con noi” presente all’interno del sito www.euregioplus.com entro il 30/09/2026

review_candidates.title: Specialist Global Allotments
review_candidates.description: DHL Express - a company that connects people! What makes DHL great? Our People! We know each employee’s individual contributions make us the #1 Express Delivery and Logistics Company in the world. Distinguished as No.1 World’s Best Workplace™ by Great Place to Work and Fortune Magazine DHL Express is committed to maintaining an environment that empowers every team member to make the greatest possible impact on our business. Our corporate culture is about personal commitment – to our business, to each other and to our global communities. DHL is dedicated to being a great place to work. Start YOUR career with DHL today! We are looking for a Specialist Global Allotments based in Diegem, Belgium, to support DHL Express' global capacity management strategy by ensuring accurate capacity forecasts and customer allotments are effectively managed across the network. In this role, you will play a vital part in balancing supply and demand, enabling the ACS Sales teams to maximize revenue opportunities while ensuring optimal utilization of network capacity. Working closely with Capacity Management, Network Planning, Operations, and Sales teams across the globe, you will monitor forecast data, manage customer allotments, analyze utilization trends, and identify opportunities to improve network performance. Through your expertise in capacity planning and space optimization, you will help ensure that DHL continues to deliver industry-leading service and operational efficiency. How will you contribute to the success of DHL? Ensure capacity forecasts meet quality standards and are correctly uploaded into downstream applications and systems. Monitor forecast data flows and proactively resolve issues affecting data quality or availability. Process and maintain customer allotment requests within agreed service levels and timelines. Analyze customer allocation requirements and provide recommendations that support revenue growth and network optimization. Monitor space utilization and identify opportunities for sales steering activities to improve network contribution. Conduct regular analysis of allotment performance, traffic flows, and utilization trends. Ensure the right traffic flows are aligned to available flight and network capacity. Work closely with Network and Capacity Management teams to maximize the utilization of seasonal and structural capacity. Monitor network capacity changes and maintain accurate capacity settings within iCargo. Support revenue generation by ensuring the accuracy of available sellable capacity. Act as a key point of contact for the Global ACS Sales community regarding customer allocation requests and capacity-related inquiries. Support and provide backup for the manager on allocation management topics when required. Collaborate with ACS regions to resolve recurring capacity and allocation challenges. Identify and implement solutions for conflicting regional requirements and operational constraints. Serve as a central contact point for day-to-day capacity management and allotment-related issues. Do you have what it takes? University degree or equivalent professional experience; a cargo-related qualification is considered an advantage. 3-5 years of experience as a Capacity Planner within DHL or a comparable logistics, airline, or cargo environment. Strong knowledge of DHL products, operational processes, and network structures. Understanding of aircraft and truck specifications and their impact on capacity planning. Strong expertise in load planning, space optimization, and capacity utilization. Experience working with capacity forecasting, allocation management, and demand planning processes. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to balance competing priorities. Basic knowledge of statistical analysis techniques used for forecasting and optimization. High attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy. Ability to make sound decisions in a fast-paced and operationally complex environment. Flexibility to adjust plans quickly in response to changing demand or network disruptions. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. Ability to collaborate effectively with Sales, Operations, Capacity Management, and customers. Proficiency in Microsoft Office and other relevant planning and operational systems; experience with iCargo is an advantage. Excellent written and spoken English. What do we offer? A key role supporting the optimization of DHL Express' global air network capacity. The opportunity to directly influence revenue generation and network utilization. Exposure to global stakeholders across Sales, Operations, Capacity Management, and Aviation functions. A dynamic international environment with collaboration across regions and business units. The opportunity to work with industry-leading systems, tools, and processes. A role that combines data analysis, operational planning, and commercial decision-making. Continuous learning and professional development opportunities. A collaborative culture focused on service excellence, innovation, and teamwork. Competitive compensation and benefits package. The opportunity to contribute to the success of the world's leading international express logistics provider. Please submit your application along with your CV and a copy of your highest educational degree (e.g., Bachelor’s, Master’s, or MBA certificate). DHL is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Recruitment Team

Le réseau Elsan Prévention poursuit une trajectoire de croissance rapide à l’échelle nationale: 5 centres en exploitation et 5 ouvertures programmées à court/moyen terme. Chaque centre déploie 3 activités : vaccination internationale, centre de santé, bilans de santé et campagnes de prévention, nécessitant industrialisation des process et montée en charge. review_candidates.description: About Norwegian The Norwegian group is a leading Nordic aviation company, owning two leading airlines in the Nordics: Norwegian Air Shuttle and Widerøe’s Flyveselskap. Norwegian operates an extensive network connecting the Nordics with major European cities, while Widerøe primarily serves short-runway airports in rural Norway, providing vital regional connectivity. Our people are the heart of Norwegian. We embrace a culture of diversity, equality, and inclusion. This is essential to our success and makes us stronger together. Are you our new Senior Manager Digital Governance Operations? As our new Senior Manager Digital Governance Operations, you will join Norwegian's newly established Group Digital & Regulatory Governance function within IT & Business Services, based at Fornebu, and take a central role in building and running our Group-wide capability for digital and regulatory governance across a complex international organisation. Reporting to the VP Group Digital Governance & Regulatory Affairs, you will be the senior operational lead for the function's prioritised governance and regulatory matters. You will help turn regulatory requirements and governance priorities into practical ways of working and drive coordinated implementation across the organisation. A key part of your role will be to bring structure and momentum to cross-functional matters, ensuring relevant stakeholders are involved, the necessary information is gathered, agreed actions are followed up and matters are escalated when necessary. Our scope includes GDPR and privacy, NIS2, Digitalsikkerhetsloven and related digital security regulation, the EU AI Act and AI governance, supplier and third-party governance, EASA Part-IS interfaces and other emerging digital regulation relevant to the Group. As we build this capability, you will also have a real opportunity to shape how we operate and support the organisation in practice. In this role, you will: Run and continuously improve the function's governance processes, working methods and follow-up structures, identifying recurring issues and turning them into better guidance, clearer ownership and more scalable solutions that reduce reliance on key individuals. Translate regulatory requirements and governance priorities into practical roadmaps, implementation plans, processes and follow-up structures, maintain a structured view of key requirements and implementation needs across prioritised areas, and lead selected governance workstreams through implementation. Advise on new business and digital initiatives by structuring assessments across relevant regulatory areas, identifying key requirements, bringing together the right specialists and helping drive pragmatic solutions from initial scoping through implementation and follow-up. Coordinate cross-functional governance and regulatory matters, provide senior operational guidance and act as an escalation point for colleagues and business stakeholders, securing the necessary input and keeping matters moving efficiently. Develop dashboards, reporting and decision-support materials for management and relevant governance forums, and take a leading functional role in improving governance tools and digital solutions, identifying opportunities to simplify, standardise and automate recurring work. Act as the first operational coordination point for selected regulatory issues and incidents, gathering facts, structuring information, engaging relevant stakeholders and preparing matters for assessment or escalation where needed. You will also manage documentation and follow-up in selected matters involving regulatory authorities. We believe you will thrive in this role if you: Have relevant higher education in law, business, technology, risk management or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience. Bring solid experience from one or more relevant areas such as governance, regulatory affairs, compliance, risk, business operations, advisory or transformation, ideally from a complex or regulated organisation. Experience with areas such as GDPR, NIS2/Digitalsikkerhetsloven, AI governance or other digital regulation is an advantage. Have strong analytical skills and a track record of getting to the heart of complex or loosely defined matters, identifying what is needed and establishing clear next steps. Have experience translating requirements or strategic priorities into workable processes, roadmaps, implementation plans or cross-functional initiatives, and understand how regulation, accountability and governance translate into effective execution and follow-through in complex organisations. Are comfortable working with dashboards, systems and digital tools and can turn complex information into clear and useful management reporting and decision support, while identifying opportunities to improve how work is structured and delivered. Communicate confidently with senior stakeholders and are comfortable asking for the information you need, challenging constructively where needed and moving matters forward without relying on formal line authority. You combine sound judgement with strong execution skills and are hands-on, independent and structured, with the maturity to balance pace, quality and stakeholder considerations. review_candidates.title: Senior Consultant
review_candidates.description: Picture your typical week: on Monday you’re on-site at a pharmaceutical client, leading a cross-functional team through a critical MES go-live. By Wednesday you’re working with the IT leadership to turn your delivery results into a business case for the next phase. Friday, you’re back at Emendo’s Nordhavn office sharing what you learned and sharpening the methods your colleagues will use on their projects. If that sounds like work you’d love, keep reading. Why We’re Hiring Now We paused hiring over the past year to be deliberate about the team we build next. The consulting market in Denmark has tightened, and our clients have changed how they buy: they want fewer consultants with more experience, people who can walk into a complex situation and show measurable progress within weeks, not months. We are now making a small number of senior hires — each one matters, and we are taking the time to find the right people. About Emendo Emendo is a 200-person consultancy built by people who used to sit on the client side — running transformation programmes inside pharma before deciding to do it for a living. We understand the pressure a site director feels before a go-live, we know what an inspector looks for, and we speak the language of the people who operate the systems we implement. We work across the full pharmaceutical value chain from R&D through shipping, with offices in Copenhagen, Kalundborg, Odense, Silkeborg, Munich, and Raleigh (USA). Our strategy is simple: deliver faster, prove value in hard numbers, and use our methods and AI tools to do what we do well — only quicker. We are a methods-driven firm rooted in operational excellence and Lean. Our motto, Observe, Think, Improve , is itself a method: go to the floor, understand what is actually happening, analyse it rigorously, then design and implement a concrete improvement. That simplicity is what makes it reliable when the project gets complicated and the usual playbooks stop working. The Role You will lead IT/OT transformation engagements for clients in pharma and regulated industries — operating at the intersection of technology, business process, and organisational change. You are expected to create measurable impact from the outset, build trusted relationships with client stakeholders, and identify opportunities to expand Emendo’s footprint within your accounts. At Emendo, seniority means more than years served: it means sound judgement in ambiguity, credibility with demanding stakeholders, and the willingness to raise the standard of the whole team. What You Will Do Lead client engagements on-site, owning delivery of IT/OT implementations across enterprise, operations management, process control, and process equipment layers Drive measurable progress in short cycles — the kind your client’s leadership can point to in a steering committee: cost reduced, lead time shortened, risk closed out Manage project governance, solution architecture alignment, and validation concepts within complex, multi-stakeholder environments Shape how Emendo works — contribute to our methods, package what you learn into repeatable offerings and case studies, and use AI tools to deliver faster without cutting corners Build lasting client relationships — become a trusted partner to your stakeholders, spot opportunities for follow-on work, and contribute to Emendo’s business development by turning strong delivery into new engagements Apply Observe, Think, Improve as your foundation — and mentor junior colleagues to do the same What It Takes Must-Have Qualifications Master’s degree in engineering, IT, or a related discipline 6–10+ years of hands-on delivery experience in IT/OT project management, product ownership, or solution implementation — ideally within pharma or other regulated industries, though strong candidates from adjacent sectors are welcome Track record of delivering quantifiable business outcomes (cost reduction, lead-time improvement, risk mitigation) — not just on-time/on-budget projects Strong command of project governance, stakeholder management, and the ability to engage credibly with C-suite and senior client leadership Deep understanding of at least one area: enterprise systems (ERP/MES), process control, IT–OT convergence, or value chain technology Fluent English, both written and spoken; Danish skills are strongly preferred, or a commitment to learn Willingness to work on-site at client locations in Denmark and occasionally internationally Nice to have — but not required None of the following are dealbreakers. If you tick even one or two, it tells us you will ramp up faster — but we have seen great consultants arrive without any of them and build the expertise here. Experience with GxP compliance, computer system validation (CSV/CSA), or regulatory frameworks in life sciences Familiarity with AI/automation tools applied to enterprise transformation or operational settings Background in operational excellence, Lean, or continuous improvement methodologies Experience working across multiple sites or geographies in global transformation programmes Comfort with outcome-based or fixed-price engagement models What Makes Emendo Different Measured on outcomes, not utilisation — you work directly with industry leaders on engagements that matter One integrated firm with deep methods: cross-unit collaboration across Implementation, Engineering, Digital, and R&D, backed by a Lean toolbox and AI accelerators Freedom under responsibility — challenging projects with room to shape the solution and your own career A flat culture where your input matters and your wins are celebrated Competitive compensation reflecting the seniority and impact expected in this role This role is probably not for you if: You prefer purely advisory work with limited implementation responsibility. You work best with narrow ownership and very clear boundaries. You have strong technical exposure but limited experience leading cross-functional change. Ready to Make an Impact? We are hiring two to three Senior Consultants this year. Each one joins a team that has led some of the largest IT/OT programmes in US and European pharma — people who chose Emendo because they wanted senior-level impact in a firm that still feels personal. If that resonates, we’d like to hear from you. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. We will be in touch promptly. For further information, reach out to Mikael Elley (me@emendo.com or +45 24 83 62 01).

review_candidates.title: Leadership Search Specialist
review_candidates.description: 1) Purpose To lead the leadership search function across international schools in the defined territory and further abroad, and to build trusting relationships with heads of school, founders and school governance boards such that edeq becomes the provider of choice for senior leadership recruitment. 2) Approach Our approach to senior leadership recruitment is relationship-based and driven by a deep understanding of the needs and challenges facing independent and international schools. We offer a full-service, discreet search process, open and closed, to deliver the highest-calibre candidates and to ensure their transition and ongoing success. 3) The service Engagement Board briefing and governance alignment: establishing who decides, and on what basis Role and person specification developed with the board Remuneration and package benchmarking against comparable schools and markets Search strategy, timeline and communications plan, including internal candidate handling Search Market mapping across target schools, systems and geographies Discreet direct approach, closed search, alongside advertised campaign where appropriate Longlist with written rationale, preliminary interviews, and assessments Structured assessment: competency-based interview, safeguarding-focused interview, psychometric profiling, and a task or presentation relevant to the school’s context Selection Shortlist report to the board, with development areas stated as plainly as strengths Panel design, interview training for governors, and stakeholder engagement sessions Full referencing and safer recruitment verification Offer negotiation, package structuring and contracting support Transition Structured onboarding plan agreed with board and appointee before the start date Quarterly reviews with the appointee and the chair through the first year First-year mentoring or executive coaching, chargeable separately or bundled A 12-month appointment review with the board Post Process Candidate Follow-Up Post processing of every short listed candidate and note to all applicants Targeted follow up with promising candidates and follow up discussions 3) The person Essential Five or more years in international or independent education, human resources, or executive search into the education sector Direct experience of working with, reporting to, or serving on a school governing board An evidenced personal network across IB, British curriculum, American curriculum, bilingual and national-plus schools; or a documented plan, and existing relationships sufficient to build such a network within twelve months Working knowledge of the ownership and governance models in the sector: proprietor-owned, foundation, not-for-profit, and group or platform-owned schools A demonstrable record of business development. This is a build role. Fluent English, and high-level formal and informal communication Willingness and availability to travel Understanding of, and unqualified commitment to, safer recruitment practice Desirable Additional languages: German, French or Spanish Familiarity with ISI, BSO, CIS, NEASC or IB evaluation frameworks Existing relationships with school ownership groups and investors in the sector Strong knowledge of employment and immigration law in Europe Attributes The highest level of interpersonal skill and cultural confidence; deep sector knowledge; the ability to engage credibly with long-term strategic planning at board level; and a clear understanding of what it takes to succeed in international school leadership. Tactical and tenacious in outreach, with a structured approach to advisory engagements, and able to nurture a pipeline of current and aspirant leaders across Europe, the United Kingdom and beyond while maintaining the highest standards of professionalism and support. 4) Sector compliance requirements Safer recruitment standards Practice aligned to the principles of Keeping Children Safe in Education, the International Task Force on Child Protection safeguarding standards, and the British International Schools Safeguarding Coalition code of conduct. Documented process, evidenced to the standard an ISI, BSO, CIS or IB evaluation would expect, and handed to the board as part of the appointment file. Verification carried out on every candidate presented Identity and right-to-work verification Full chronological employment history, with every gap explained and recorded References taken from all employers in the last ten years, sought from the institution rather than the individual, and always including the current or most recent employer Criminal record checks in every country of residence or employment: UK DBS and ICPC where applicable, local equivalents elsewhere, and an international child protection certificate where available Qualification verification direct with the awarding institution Proportionate and documented online presence check A safeguarding-focused interview, recorded, with the responses provided to the board Candidate self-declaration, and a documented process for handling disclosures Data protection particulars

review_candidates.title: Intelligence Analyst, Blockchain & Crypto
review_candidates.description: Overview Working within the Rights & Revenue Protection (RRP) team, the Intelligence Analyst, Blockchain & Crypto will support investigations relating to the protection and enforcement of Sportradar's intellectual property and revenue recovery efforts through blockchain intelligence, cryptocurrency tracing and digital asset investigations. The role will primarily focus on monitoring and analysing the emerging prediction market ecosystem, including participants, market makers, liquidity providers and associated entities, to enhance Sportradar's understanding of data and content usage, market activity and potential commercial risks. The analyst will also support broader investigations involving sports betting operators, digital platforms and other organisations utilising blockchain and cryptocurrency technologies. THE CHALLENGE Conduct intelligence investigations using an all-source approach across rights protection, enforcement and revenue recovery matters. Perform blockchain analysis and cryptocurrency tracing to identify transaction flows, wallet relationships, beneficial owners and networks of interest. Collect, analyse and evaluate intelligence from open-source, cyber and blockchain-based sources. Conduct OSINT, CYBINT/DNINT and cryptocurrency investigations to deliver actionable intelligence and recommendations. Monitor and analyse prediction market ecosystems, identifying key participants, market makers, liquidity providers and emerging platforms. Conduct investigations relating to sports-focused prediction markets, including wallet attribution, transaction tracing and ecosystem mapping. Analyse cryptocurrency transaction data and behavioural patterns to identify links between users, entities and platforms. Develop and maintain intelligence holdings relating to cryptocurrency-enabled services, exchanges, wallets and payment methods. Produce intelligence products including analytical assessments, investigative reports, link analysis and stakeholder briefings. Monitor emerging blockchain technologies, trends and risks relevant to Sportradar, intellectual property protection and revenue recovery activities. Support collaboration with internal stakeholders, external partners and industry organisations. Contribute to the ongoing evaluation and implementation of investigative technologies and blockchain analytics platforms. YOUR PROFILE 2+ years' experience in intelligence, investigations, law enforcement, cyber security, financial crime, fraud, due diligence or digital asset investigations. Experience conducting analytical investigations and producing intelligence-led outputs. Demonstrable understanding of cryptocurrency ecosystems including Bitcoin, Ethereum, stablecoins, exchanges, wallets, bridges and decentralised finance (DeFi). Experience using blockchain analytics platforms such as Chainalysis Reactor, TRM Forensics, Elliptic Investigator or similar. Familiarity with the functionality of prediction markets, market makers and liquidity providers essential. Experience working with APIs and structured data sources to collect, extract and analyse information from blockchain, prediction market and other online platforms. Proficient and demonstrable expertise in OSINT, CYBINT/DNINT or intelligence tradecraft methodologies. Strong analytical, critical thinking and problem-solving skills. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce clear, concise reports and present findings to diverse audiences. Awareness of data protection legislation and associated implications. High level of integrity, discretion, and commitment to confidentiality and information security. Self-motivated, analytical, and naturally inquisitive, with a proactive approach to problem-solving and investigation. Adaptable and resilient, with the ability to manage changing priorities, work effectively under tight deadlines. Fluent in English; additional language skills are a plus. Advantageous Experience with intelligence analysis tools such as i2 Analyst's Notebook, Maltego or similar. Understanding of financial crime typologies, asset tracing, sanctions evasion and illicit finance risks. Knowledge of intellectual property enforcement, anti-piracy activities, sports betting or gaming industries. Understanding of decentralised applications (dApps), digital asset market structure and trading ecosystems. Relevant certifications such as Chainalysis Reactor Certification, TRM Academy, CAMS, CFCS or CFE. Our Offer A collaborative environment with colleagues from all over the world (Offices in Europe, Asia and US) including various social events and teambuilding. Flexibility to manage your workday and tasks with autonomy. A balance of structure and autonomy to tackle your daily tasks. Vibrant and inclusive community, including Women in Tech and Pride groups which welcome all participants. Global Employee Assistance Programme. Calm and Reulay app (leading well-being apps designed to support focus, quality rest, mindfulness, and long-term mental resilience). Online training videos. Flexible working hours. While we appreciate the flexibility and benefits of working from home, we strongly believe that coming together in person fosters stronger connections, encourages collaboration, and drives innovation—both as individuals and as a company. The energy, shared ideas, and team support we experience in the office strengthen the foundation of our success and culture. For this reason, we are an office-first business operating on a fully on-site model, with team members working in the office five days a week to build relationships, exchange ideas, and grow together. Our Recruitment Process Initial Screening : A quick chat with our Talent Acquisition Partner to understand your background and expectations. Two Hiring Team Interviews : Meet with the Hiring team and Hiring Manager to dive into your expertise, as also discuss team fit. Assessment : Investigative task to showcase your technical skills. Final Steps : Receive feedback and, if successful, an offer!

review_candidates.title: ITEA & Trials Engineer
review_candidates.description: What We Are Looking For At OMNIA Training, we’ve brought together some of the UK’s most innovative defence training organisations into a single consortium to delivery one powerful mission: to transform the British Army’s training system and create the best-trained Army in the world. OMNIA Training will redefine the British Army’s collective training, standing up as the Army’s Strategic Training Partner. To do that, we are looking for the best and brightest minds from across the UK. We are backed by British innovation and powered by world-class experts, like you. OMNIA Training is primed by Raytheon UK, but all five partners (Raytheon, Rheinmetall, Capita, Skyral and Cervus) are key to delivering the scope of the contract. This is more than a job — it’s a mission. You will be part of a high-impact, collaborative environment, where we expect everyone to live the values and standards of the British Army. Every person in our team plays a critical role in delivering OMNIA Training’s vision; designing, delivering, and transforming collective training so the British Army is ready to fight and win. The Role: This role is the Integrated Test, Evaluation and Acceptance (ITEA) and Trials Engineer, who is responsible for assigned OMNIA ITEA and Trials activities on behalf of the Configuring Service. Reporting: This position reports directly to the ITEA & Trials Lead Engineer. Job Description: As a member of the Integration, Test, Evaluation, and Acceptance (ITEA) team, you will contribute to the rigorous testing, verification, and validation of new and updated Products, Services, and Systems (PSS). Working under the guidance of the ITEA Lead, your efforts will support the smooth transition of capabilities into the ACTS service, ensuring alignment with Defence architectural standards, safety requirements, and interoperability goals. You will assist in the planning, coordination, and execution of structured testing and trials as part of the Verification, Trial, and Experimentation Plan (VTEP). Your work will help confirm that solutions meet defined capability and integration requirements. This role offers the opportunity to work within advanced test environments and collaborate with engineering, acquisition, and operational teams across Defence. You will play an important part in validating capability performance, supporting system interoperability, and ensuring readiness for service across next-generation simulation training systems. Responsibilies & Tasks: Trial Planning & Execution: Execute the Verification, Trial and Experimentation Plan (VTEP) Develop the Integrated Test, Evaluation and Acceptance Plan (ITEAP) from the VTEP, including: Subordinate Test and Trials Plans Capability Integration Plans Stakeholder analysis Data capture and reporting strategies Resource requirements (tools, equipment, data, personnel) Capability Integration & Testing: Ensure all PSS align with architectural frameworks, including: Compliance and enhancement of the ACTS Technology Roadmap Generic Base Architecture (GBA) Generic Vehicle Architecture (GVA) Generic Soldier Architecture (GSA) Verify system interoperability with: Existing and legacy systems Other ACTS services and data sources Directed external dependencies Trials & Acceptance: Conduct progressive testing and trials including: Pilot / Concept Trials Initial Integration Trials User Acceptance Trials (UAT) Leverage the testing environment to: What Qualifications You Should Have Validate interoperability and integration Support Live, Virtual, and Constructive (LVC) blended simulation environments Enable dynamic injects, performance analysis, and After-Action Reviews (AARs) Participate in and support: Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) Critical Design Reviews (CDR) Safety and Environmental compliance testing Produce and deliver: Acceptance Case Reports (ACRs) Trial Reports Safety & Environmental Case Reports Governance & Lifecycle Support: Support governance of ITEA activities across the capability lifecycle. Ensure access to and configuration of engineering information and test evidence across the PSS lifecycle. Validate PSS against ISO 44001-aligned acquisition and supply chain management principles. Skills: Required: Degree in Engineering, Systems Engineering, Defence Technology, or a related discipline. Experience in Test & Evaluation, System Integration, or Trials Engineering in a Defence, or similar environment. Demonstrated experience in executing trials. Analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and the ability to work independently and cooperatively in a distributed team Good communication and teamwork skills Knowledge and confidence in technical publications Combined Arms Tactical Trainer (CATT) Virtual Battlespace (VBS), Tactical Engagement Simulation (TES), Command and Staff Trainer (CAST) Combined Arms Virtual Dismounted (CAV-D)(V). Understanding of the Strategic Defence Review (SDR 2025) Desirable: Experience with open training and simulation standards: High-Level Architecture (HLA) Distributed Interactive Simulation (DIS) UCATT, MILES, or similar systems Knowledge of CT systems, mission training tools, and synthetic environments. Familiarity with the UK MOD Land Industrial Strategy, acquisition lifecycle, and ITEA governance models (e.g. Knowledge in Defence (KiD), Defence Equipment and Support processes (DE&S). Experience with Defence architectural compliance (e.g. GBA, GSA, GVA) and capability development frameworks, or equivalent. Postgraduate qualifications or certification in Systems Engineering (e.g., INCOSE), Test & Evaluation, or Program Management. Previous defence experience Applicants must be willing to work within the Defence sector and undertake Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) and Security Clearance (SC) checks, if not already held. Personal Attributes: We are looking for individuals who want to serve. You’ll have a mission focus, and the enthusiasm and drive to ‘get things done’. You’ll want to work in collaboration with other defence training organisations, and the British Army. You won’t let bureaucracy get in the way of what needs to be done, you’ll learn lessons and share these lessons across the team. You won’t necessarily have a military background, but you’ll understand what it means to serve and to put the mission first. What We Offer You We want REUK to be the employer you choose to build your career with. We have lots of opportunity to grow as our business continues to grow. We are proud to be a Disability Confident employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace for all. We are proud supporters of the Armed Forces Community. We welcome applications from Veterans, Reservists, Cadet Force Adult Volunteers and military spouses and partners. We are passionate about finding the right people to join us and we want you to be proud to work with us. Our vision is to become a recognised and respected solution provider while delivering high-technology, high reliability & high-quality products and systems. As an REUK Employee we offer you: 25 Days holiday plus Bank holidays (increasing with service) Flexible Working 4-times Death-in-Service Scheme (3 months of service) BUPA Healthcare & Dental-Care Insurance (after successful completion of probation period) Long Service Rewards with additional holidays Enhanced Employer Pension contributions of 6.8% Salary sacrifice schemes for Cycle to Work Excellent Training Opportunities Recommend a friend scheme Buying & Selling of Annual Leave Staff social events throughout the year Recognition for your work CONTACT INFORMATION Applicants must be willing to work within the Defence sector and undertake Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) and Security Clearance (SC) checks, if not already held. To apply, please submit your CV to sam.pollard@rheinmetall.com

We’re looking for an experienced Senior DevOps Lead to lead our Logging and Monitoring initiatives and drive the development of robust, scalable observability solutions within Google Cloud Platform (GCP). In this role, you’ll help build systems that give software engineers greater visibility into the health, performance, and reliability of their applications and services. You’ll oversee a modern observability technology stack that includes Elastic Cloud, Loki, Grafana Labs, and the ELK stack for logging, as well as Zabbix, Captain Hook, and Anodot for metrics, monitoring, and anomaly detection. You Will: Key Responsibilities & Impact Lead the design, implementation, operation, and continuous improvement of LivePerson’s observability platforms across logs, metrics, traces, alerting, and synthetic monitoring. Own and optimize large-scale observability pipelines processing high volumes of telemetry data daily, leveraging technologies such as Filebeat, Kafka, Logstash, Elastic Cloud, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, Grafana Labs, Zabbix, Anodot, and related tools. Design, build, and maintain scalable, Kubernetes-based observability services using Helm, CI/CD pipelines, GCP, GKE, Docker, and cloud-native best practices. Define and establish observability standards, dashboards, alerting frameworks, best practices, and onboarding resources for hundreds of engineering users. Partner closely with DevOps, SRE, Engineering, NOC, Security, and vendor teams to deliver reliable, scalable, and actionable observability solutions. Evaluate emerging observability technologies and drive adoption of modern practices in areas such as OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, anomaly detection, and proactive monitoring. Lead the design and development of an end-to-end Synthetic Monitoring platform, running hundreds of daily synthetic tests on GCP Spot VMs to enable proactive service validation and help engineering teams identify potential issues before they impact customers. Provide technical leadership and mentorship, driving best practices across observability, DevOps, and cloud engineering. You Have: Required Skills & Qualifications 5+ years of experience in software engineering, DevOps, SRE, or a related discipline, with a strong background in application development and cloud engineering. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. Strong experience with Kubernetes and containerization technologies, including Docker. Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation. Experience working with cloud platforms such as GCP, AWS, or Azure, including compute, storage, networking, and related cloud services. Strong programming and scripting skills in one or more languages, such as Go, Java, JavaScript, or Python. Experience designing and operating highly available, scalable, production-grade systems. Strong understanding of CI/CD practices and cloud-native development methodologies. Experience with OpenTelemetry Collector and Grafana Agent is highly preferred. Volunteering Days: Use them to make a difference in your community. Whether it's a cleanup, supporting a local initiative or holding an “Ehrenamt”, just let us know! We're here to help you create a meaningful impact. 💻 Workplace Flexibility Remote-First Model: Be flexible, work flexibly and from anywhere - no defined working hours or boundaries with offices in Mannheim and Berlin Monthly Connection: Join our monthly connection pizza day in the office! The strategy is set, the data sources are identified, and the first phase is mapped — what's missing is the person who builds it, validates it with real signal, and gives it speed. You'll turn market data — public per-country data, plus signal scraped from Booking and Airbnb — into a repeatable engine that generates qualified pipeline toward mid-market hotels and chains. This isn't a "run the sequences" role. You're building the engine, not operating someone else's. What you'll do We think in phases, not quarters — each one earned with data from the last, not with more budget. First 30 days Get two engines live in parallel: a Clay + Lemlist motion on our net-new, multi-property pipeline — with proper enrichment, multichannel sequencing, and deliverability hygiene from day one — and a HubSpot-based nurture motion on our owned database. Ship your first message-angle test with success criteria defined before you start, and put a clean handoff agreement in place with Sales. 60–90 days Hit Gate 1: a sustained reply rate above 8–10% for three-plus weeks, with a message angle you know is winning. Start moving your best accounts — the ones with real property-count signal — into 1:1 hyper-personalized outreach. Build a real feedback loop with our AEs, and document the playbook so it isn't just in your head. 180 days Hit Gate 2: your playbook works in more than one market or ICP, not just the pilot. At that point, outbound is a predictable, quota-attributable source of pipeline, not an experiment. If the case is there, this is also where you start building the "brain" of the system — signal scoring, message QA, routing — without touching the deliverability layer that's already working. What you'll bring You've done this before, not just run it: Demonstrable experience building and validating B2B outbound from scratch, with real results to show for it — reply rate, meetings, pipeline — not just executing sequences someone else designed. Hands-on with the stack: Clay or Apify, Lemlist (or Smartlead / Instantly), HubSpot, and Make or n8n. You take deliverability seriously — warmup, domain rotation, LinkedIn limits — because you've seen what happens when it's ignored. AI is part of your actual daily workflow, not a buzzword: research, copy, scoring, and personalization at scale. Day to day, you're comfortable with: Designing an outbound playbook end-to-end — signal, message, response — not just running what's handed to you. Sourcing and structuring data: scraping, enrichment, and cleaning, using tools like Clay and Apify. Multichannel sequencing (email + LinkedIn) with the deliverability discipline to keep it working at volume. Operating HubSpot like an owner: lists, workflows, lead routing, and knowing why cold outbound comes in as a lead, not an MQL. Automating logic in Make or n8n as the system matures. Reading your own funnel — reply rate, cost per meeting, cost per opportunity — and using it to decide what to do next. Nice to have: experience with per-prospect reasoning tools like Enginy for hyper-personalized outreach at the top of the funnel. What we offer Base salary range from 40000€ to 45000€ yearly.
